main_text.p: nem relegant ; verbi caufa , fumma Ver- fuum à Maforetis in Pfalmis fic adnota- tur, אאכוך[?], 2527, natura duce fic fcribi- debuiffet, אאכן, alias pro duobus א uterentur ב. Saepe millenarios omit- tunt, & inferiores tantum numeros ad- fcribunt, qvod faepiffime faciunt, cùm annos Epochae mundi numerant, fed tum faepius addunt פק. hoc eft, פרט קשון, juxta Numerum minorem. Ex- empli caufa, aliud hoc anno accidiffe dicerent, שנח שעא[?], anno 391, juxta Numerum minorem , hoc eft , anno mundi juxta ipforum Numeros, השעא[?], ʒ391. Sed de hifce hactenus. Pentateu- chi 17 caput Leviitici fub praelo eft. Pen- tateuchum tuum integrum cum Hebraeo Samaritano contuli ; tam exacta eft, & verbis adhaerens verfio , ut Latina dupli- ci minime fit opus, unaqve verfio utri- qve textui ad amuffim refpondeat ; al- teram verfionem condere, prorfus esta- ctum agere. Ita autem Samaritanus uter- qve codex in editione difponitur, ut La- tina verfio utriqve textui ex aequo re-

page.notes: Hebrew words in lines 3, 4, 9, 10, 12 and 14 are printed in a small, heavy face and are partly blurred; the letters are as far as I can make them out, and those marked [?] are doubtful. The numeral before "391" on the line after "Numeros" is a special symbol (ʒ), not clearly a Latin or Hebrew figure. The 2527 in line 3 is copied as printed. The "s" in "esta-" (line 22) is printed as a long-s-like form and is copied as printed. Ink smudges to the right of the text are not printed text and are left out.
